scientific.claim_scope: All nondegenerate Euclidean orthotopes in dimensions at least three; Haar-uniform orthogonal planar projections; the first two moments and the variance of projected Euclidean perimeter.
scientific.integrity: The proof uses a direct conditional-Haar beta-hypergeometric evaluation, not an unchecked numerical conjecture. The full texts of the initiating regular-polytope paper, Finch's closest periwidth calculation, and a related random-projection central limit theorem were compared by mathematical implication. The bundled verifier independently tests the integral, convex hull, and numerical examples.
limitations: The exact three-cube second moment and all one-dimensional width moments are published prior results and are explicitly credited.
The new result does not cover arbitrary non-orthogonal parallelotopes, higher moments, or the full perimeter distribution.
General Gaussian representation identities are prior; the specific pairwise projected-perpendicular-edge kernel is evaluated here.
Unindexed integral-geometric or random-zonotope literature remains a historical overlap risk; no independent audit has been performed.

title: Haar-random planar projection perimeter moments of all orthotopes
